description: Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Maryland | Department of Geographical Sciences; NASA Applied Sciences Program; Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations. This system distributes active fire data derived from instruments on satellites. For the US and Canada, active fire detections are available in real-time; globally, these data are generally available within 3 hours of satellite observation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Wildfire. Assets: Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
